flowering.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production-ready transparent 2D Peony FLOWERING-stage sprite for the cozy Anki Garden game. Redesign the referenced Peony into a cohesive, polished storybook gouache plant while preserving its coral, blush and peach flower identity and burgundy-green stems. Exactly FOUR open ruffled peony blooms: one slightly higher cream-peach bloom, two coral side blooms, and one smaller blush bloom in front. Give the plant a rounded, leafy three-stem bush silhouette with broad divided botanical leaf groups, muted sage-to-deep-green foliage, larger readable painted planes and soft organic edges. Leaves must remain connected and substantial at a 40px thumbnail. Match the supplied painterly style but simplify scratchy microtexture and eliminate glossy/photo-like sheen. Flowers should look like irregular layered peony cups, not identical rose spirals. Whole plant visible, stem crown centered at the bottom, no roots hanging down, no soil, no pot, no ground plane, no cast shadow. Mild warm upper-right light, subtle cool left fill; balanced midtones with restrained cream highlights, no bloom glow. Square 2048x2048 canvas requested, genuinely transparent RGBA background. Plant occupies about 76% of canvas width and 86% of canvas height, with generous completely transparent padding on every edge. No labels, lettering, border, watermark, particles, background color or checkerboard. Return ONE isolated plant, not a sheet or variants.
